records.description: SafePal disclosed exposure of customer order information affecting approximately 40,000 customers. SafePal stated that private keys and seed phrases were not compromised.
records.notes: This is a customer/order-data privacy incident, not a wallet private-key, seed-phrase, or key-storage compromise. WLR does not infer compromise of wallet software, hardware, or signing keys from this disclosure.
records.title: Customer order data exposure disclosed

records.description: SafePal states that the S1 hardware wallet opened for sale on May 27, 2019, marking the commercial release of its first hardware wallet.
records.notes: The release date uses SafePal’s first-party progress update. Current SafePal history independently places the official S1 launch in May 2019.
records.title: SafePal S1 opened for sale

records.description: SafePal announced the official launch of its browser extension wallet on August 19, 2022.
records.notes: The historical launch announcement listed Chrome, Firefox and Microsoft Edge. Current supported-browser status is governed separately by current distribution evidence and is not inferred from this 2022 event.
records.title: SafePal Extension Wallet officially launched

records.description: SafePal records the official launch and open-source release of its X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet in September 2023.
records.notes: Month-level precision is retained because the contemporaneous 2023-09-13 CEO letter announced the launch while still referencing preorder availability; no exact commercial-release day is inferred.
records.title: SafePal X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet officially launched

records.description: SafePal announced on September 7, 2023 that the S1 Pro was ready for distribution through official SafePal channels and available to order.
records.notes: The release date uses SafePal’s direct first-party S1 Pro release announcement rather than a later retrospective.
records.title: SafePal S1 Pro released through official channels

records.description: SafePal officially released SafePal Lite inside the SafePal App, allowing users to create or import self-custody software wallets in addition to using the App as a companion for SafePal hardware wallets.
records.notes: This event records the software-wallet capability release, not the initial SafePal App launch. First-party SafePal posts show that the App already existed in 2019.
records.title: SafePal App added self-custody software-wallet capability

records.description: SafePal's first-party 2019 history establishes an active mobile-app release lineage, including an official App version announcement and a later statement that nine App versions had already been released.
records.notes: Year precision only. The July 2019 source concerns a DEX-capable official App version and already refers to the SafePal App; it is not treated as the exact initial App launch day. The May 2020 Software Wallet milestone is modeled as a later capability expansion rather than the initial App release.
records.title: SafePal App released in 2019

records.notes: First-party SafePal disclosure used for the customer-order-data exposure and the explicit boundary that private keys and seed phrases were not compromised.
records.title: Security Update

records.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirming the active SafePal App, SafePal Extension Wallet, and supported SafePal S1, S1 Pro, and X1 hardware-wallet lines.
records.title: SafePal Download Center

records.notes: First-party SafePal source describing SafePal as a decentralized wallet and establishing the project as founded in 2018.
records.title: Our Response To The Security Findings From Kraken Security Labs

records.notes: First-party SafePal update explicitly states that SafePal S1 was open for sale on May 27, 2019.
records.title: SafePal Progress Update

records.notes: First-party SafePal announcement explicitly identifies August 19, 2022 as the official launch of the SafePal browser extension wallet.
records.title: The SafePal difference, now available on Chrome: Introducing SafePal Browser Extension Wallet

records.notes: First-party SafePal history records the official launch and open-source release of the X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet in September 2023.
records.title: About SafePal — Our History

records.notes: First-party SafePal release post states that the S1 Pro was ready for distribution through official SafePal channels and available to order.
records.title: SafePal releases the S1 Pro

records.notes: Primary SafePal announcement for the 2020-05-11 release of decentralized software-wallet functionality inside the existing SafePal App. It explicitly distinguishes this from the earlier hardware-wallet companion App.
records.title: SafePal Lite Software Wallet is now ALIVE

records.notes: First-party SafePal article referring to users trading through the SafePal App and announcing an official App/firmware version for July 2019. Used to establish the 2019 App release lineage, not as proof that the announced DEX version date was the initial App launch day.
records.title: Pre-announcement: Trade on DEX, with SafePal

records.notes: First-party SafePal progress report stating that nine App versions and three firmware updates had already been released. This directly establishes an active SafePal App release lineage in 2019 while leaving the exact first public store-release day unresolved.
records.title: SafePal Progress Update

records.notes: Current first-party SafePal store lists S1, X1 and S1 Pro with prices and active Buy Now purchase actions. Used only for current sales status.
records.title: SafePal Products — Hardware Wallets
